cohort: Patients admitted to postoperative surgical wards over a 2-month period.
finding: The overall incidence of SSI was 7.57%, with the highest incidence (12.69%) in the general surgery department where cefazolin was used as surgical antibiotic prophylaxis in all cases.
followup_time: 30 days post-surgery, or 1 year if an implant was left in place
